delta_scenarios.no_change: Same hash as baseline -> IR-001 -> auto-inherit CertifiedDelta
delta_scenarios.cc_changed_to_B: Hash differs -> IR-004 -> full In Audit, CAQS 10-dimension
delta_scenarios.ew_a_expanded: Hash differs (only EW changed) -> IR-002 -> targeted EW review
delta_scenarios.metadata_only: Difficulty changed -> content_hash unchanged -> IR-003 -> psychometric review
delta_scenarios.dl008_cleared: EW_D was non-empty, cleared -> content_hash UNCHANGED (engine force-clears CC slot) -> IR-005 via Gate 1 scan

4_edge_cases.description: 8 identified edge cases that could cause hash instability or incorrect delta routing

cases.name: DL-008 Non-Empty EW[CC] - Hash Invisibility
cases.description: hash_engine force-clears EW[CC] to '' before hashing. Items with and without DL-008 produce the SAME content hash.
cases.mitigation: IR-005 is the ONLY defense. Gate 1 scan MUST run before any IR-001 auto-inherit decision.
cases.recommendation: Add hard Gate 1 dependency: 'content_hash matches AND Gate 1 scan PASSES' - not 'content_hash matches AND Gate 1 was run'.

cases.name: DL-018 Absent EW[CC] Fields
cases.description: Absent EW[CC] (Pack E Section C) produces same hash as present-empty EW[CC] (normalizeText returns '').
cases.recommendation: No action needed. Delta model handles correctly. Structural normalization (adding '' fields) does NOT change content hash.

cases.name: DL-016 Metadata-Content Shift - Hash Misleads
cases.description: DL-016 items have EW text describing DIFFERENT QID's choices. Content hash captures the wrong EW text but cannot detect topic mismatch.
cases.mitigation: DL-016 detection requires semantic comparison. IR-002 Gate 2 boilerplate scan could be extended for topic alignment check.
cases.recommendation: Extend IR-002 to verify EW text keyword overlap with item's own Choice text.

cases.name: Concurrent Session Write - Baseline Staleness
cases.description: Concurrent pack file modifications (DL-019 scenario) break delta ledger baseline assumption.
cases.mitigation: Session-level file-lock coordination. Add versionSequence to DELTA_LEDGER entries for conflict detection.

cases.name: Newline Normalization Divergence
cases.description: Spec vs. implementation divergence on newline handling in EC text.
cases.recommendation: Update S203 spec to match implementation: collapse all whitespace to single space.

cases.name: Empty CorrectChoice - Hash Ambiguity
cases.description: Empty CC (1 item in Pack D) means force-clear logic does not execute. EW[CC] retains actual value in hash.
cases.recommendation: Gate -1 Identity Validator should flag empty CC as BLOCKED.

cases.name: Choice Rotation Without Content Change
cases.description: Positional rotation (A->B->C->D->A) changes hash but not semantics.
cases.impact: Appropriate: rotation is a psychometric change that should trigger review.
cases.recommendation: No change. Treating rotation as content change is correct.

cases.name: Unicode Normalization
cases.description: No NFC/NFD normalization. Different Unicode representations of same character produce different hashes.
cases.impact: Extremely unlikely in this English-only accounting corpus.

5_metadata_hash_validation.verdict: Spec-implementation divergence on metadata field scope (11 vs 7). Implementation is MORE conservative (more hash changes -> more review triggers). Recommend alignment.

6_identity_hash_validation.verdict: CORRECT. Compound key includes identity (QID) and content-signal (CC, template family) components. CC change -> different compound key -> correctly detects answer-key changes.

summary.hash_determinism: VERIFIED - SHA-256 + sorted keys + whitespace normalization = deterministic
summary.metadata_fields: DIVERGENT - 11 vs 7 fields. Conservative. Recommend alignment.
summary.cc_slot_force_clear: CORRECT - EW[CC] normalized to '' before hashing. Paired with IR-005 for DL-008 detection.
critical_edge_cases: EC-01: DL-008 hash invisibility - hard dependency on IR-005/Gate 1 scan
EC-03: DL-016 semantic misalignment - hash cannot detect topic mismatch
recommendations: Align S203 spec sec.29 (newline normalization) with implementation
Align metadata hash field list between spec and implementation
Add Gate 1 scan PASS as hard prerequisite for IR-001 auto-inherit
Extend IR-002 Gate 2 scan to verify EW topic alignment with choices
Add versionSequence to DELTA_LEDGER entries for concurrent-write detection
Document EC-01 through EC-08 as known limitations in delta engine spec
